arithmetic.prompt: Compute 19 times 23. End your answer with the integer result.
arithmetic.text:
To compute $19 \times 23$, we can use the standard multiplication algorithm or break it down using the distributive property.

**Method 1: Standard Multiplication**

$$
\begin{array}{r}
  23 \\
\times 19 \\
\hline
 207 & (9 \times 23) \\
230 & (10 \times 23) \\
\hline
437
\end{array}
$$

**Method 2: Distributive Property**

We can rewrite 19 as $20 - 1$:
$$
19 \times 23 = (20 - 1) \times 23
$$
$$
= (20 \times 23) - (1 \times 23)
$$
$$
= 460 - 23
$$
$$
= 437
$$

Alternatively, we can rewrite 23 as $20 + 3$:
$$
19 \times 23 = 19 \times (20 + 3)
$$
$$
= (19 \times 20) + (19 \times 3)
$$
$$
= 380 + 57
$$
$$
= 437
$$

The result is 437.

437
